items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: He wrote a nice column about me. And he said he'd read it and he'd always heard about me and he wanted to meet me and shake my hand and thank me.

ctx.x: Dan Burley, yeah. He wrote a nice column about me. And he said he'd read it and he'd always heard about me and he wanted to meet me and shake my hand and thank me. And, you know, I'm very emotional. I started to cry. But
it was like it almost made it worthwhile, somebody thought I did -- I thought, Well, Jesus, once in a while I do something right in my life.
